episodes.title: Introduction to IP
episodes.description: We're going to discuss the three major elements of IP: Copyright, Patents, and Trademarks.

episodes.title: Copyright Basics
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course Intellectual Property, Stan Muller teaches you the basics of copyright in the United States.

episodes.title: Copyright, Exceptions, and Fair Use
episodes.description: Explore copyright enforcement, its exceptions, and the complexity of applying fair use.

episodes.title: Patents, Novelty, and Trolls
episodes.description: So, patents have some similarities to copyright, in that they grant a limited monopoly to people who invent things.

episodes.title: Trademarks and Avoiding Consumer Confusion
episodes.description: In which Stan Muller teaches you about our third branch of Intellectual Property, trademarks.

episodes.title: International IP Law
episodes.description: Stan Muller teaches you how intellectual property law functions internationally.

episodes.title: IP Problems, YouTube, and the Future
episodes.description: Explore problems in intellectual property law, its application to YouTube, and possible future changes.
